url.title: Facebook Post URL
url.description: The Facebook post URL to scrape.

browserMode.title: Browser Mode
browserMode.description: Use `cdp` for an existing logged-in Chrome profile, or `managed` to launch Playwright inside the Actor.

externalChromeCdpUrl.title: External Chrome CDP URL
externalChromeCdpUrl.description: Required when browserMode is `cdp`. Example: http://localhost:9222

recordVideo.title: Record Video
recordVideo.description: Enable Playwright video recording when supported by the selected browser mode.

headless.title: Run Headless (managed mode)
headless.description: Only applies to `managed` mode. Keep false for bot-detection-sensitive sessions.

waitAfterNavigationMs.title: Wait After Navigation (ms)
waitAfterNavigationMs.description: Extra wait after opening the page before scraping begins.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy configuration for managed mode.
